I've noted the amount: EUR 240.00 for TX-0401. I still need the reason for the dispute before I can check eligibility. Your earlier messages didn't say why you are disputing this charge.

Which of these applies?

- **Duplicate charge:** you were charged twice for the same purchase. TX-0402 (EUR 240.00, TechMart Online, 2026-07-14) has the same amount and merchant.
- **Unauthorized debit:** you did not make or approve this payment.
- **Fraud, card not present:** an online payment was made with your card details without your permission.
- **Goods not received:** you paid but did not receive the item.
- **Service not rendered:** you paid for a service that was not provided.
